title: What's Actually Inside Donut Lab's Solid-State Battery?
excerpt: At CES 2026, a Finnish startup claimed the world’s first production solid-state battery: 400 Wh/kg, 5-minute charging, and 100,000-cycle life. Yet much of the conversation has been shaped by hype and marketing claims rather than direct data analysis. This post takes a deep dive into Donut Lab’s data and uncover the chemistry.
